easy.def: A very big sea of salt water.

more.def: One of the huge bodies of salt water that cover most of the Earth.
examples: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world.
Sea turtles travel across the ocean to lay eggs.
From the plane, the ocean looked endless.

more.def: The tenth month of the year, when leaves change color in many places.
examples: We carve pumpkins at the end of October.
October brings crisp air and bright red leaves.
